name: Evidence-Locked Vertical Build
description: Builds complex software through evidence-backed vertical slices, environment reality checks, canonical contracts, runtime-first execution, local repair, and production truth gates.

routing.trigger: a coding agent must implement a non-trivial product with several interdependent subsystems or long-horizon execution risk
routing.boundary: task is a small isolated edit, research-only request, or purely visual mockup with no runtime implementation requirement
invoke_conditions: full-stack product build spans multiple runtimes, tools, data stores, integrations, or workspaces
implementation must remain production-truthful and avoid mocks or silent substitutions
autonomous coding work needs staged vertical execution and verification
shared contracts should be proven before parallel expansion
runtime evidence should drive UI, replay, observability, or workflow visualization
block_conditions: task is a small one-file change with no architectural dependency
user requested review only and no implementation
task explicitly requests a disposable visual mockup rather than executable software

tools: repository reader when implementation depends on existing code
runtime/test tools appropriate to the target project
